name: Albert Garzon
bio_short: Albert Garzon is a pianist who plays ragtime, standards and blues, and who accompanied Lex Grey in "The Return of the Down and Dirty Lounge" at Holland Tunnel Gallery in 2022.
bio_long: Albert Garzon is a pianist whose repertoire centers on piano rags, standards and blues. On May 22, 2022 he joined singer Lex Grey at Holland Tunnel Gallery in Newburgh for "The Return of the Down and Dirty Lounge," two sets of rags, standards and blues that revived Grey's long-running Down and Dirty Lounge revue. His YouTube channel, published under the handle AlbertGarzonProducer, carries ragtime piano performances such as Tom Turpin's "Ragtime Nightmare" as well as a video of Lex Grey singing "Do You Know What It Means to Miss New Orleans," which documents their ongoing collaboration. Further biographical details, such as training and recordings, could not be confirmed from sources that clearly refer to the same person.
practice: Solo and accompanying piano: classic ragtime, jazz standards and blues.
